ety.text: From Ancient Greek νῦ (nû), name for the letter of the Greek alphabet Ν (N) and ν (n).
Borrowed from Yiddish נו (nu). Doublet of now.

senses.d: The letter of the Greek alphabet Ν (N) and ν (n).
A measure of constringence in lenses or prisms.
An exclamation of surprise, emphasis, doubt, etc.
Well? (Used as a question to demand an answer from someone reluctant to answer.)

grp.label: name for the letter of the Greek alphabet: Ν and ν

ety.text: Inherited from Middle French nu, from Old French nu, from Latin nūdus, from Proto-Indo-European *nogʷós.

es:ni.gl: nu; the Greek letter Ν, ν

pt:ni.gl: nu (the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet)
